original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.

actual_scope: Strict negative association of five orthogonal binary full-guard indicators under complete uniform GL_m(F2) headers for every m>=5.
scope_change_reason: The donor asks for an original result rather than a predecessor audit. Take the explicit five-indicator open question in Krzysztof Wojt PR5093 as a written counting side theorem, without proof-assistant or selected-caller admission claims.
bottleneck_link: Shared-header dependence can constrain grouping, but a physical sampler and completed consumer bill remain absent; this is a mathematical side result.
stop_rule: Ship the first proved extension; do not expand to six indicators or physical implementation.
evidence: PROOF.md and verify.py: 37 gap certificates, 4498 finite-prefix comparisons, 111 tail probes, 1108 atom/truth-table comparisons and 10 controls.

open_questions.question: Can a physical caller use a complete uniform header at favorable complete cost?

open_questions.blocked_by: A physical consumer and its complete bill are absent.

overlap.coverage: Live open PRs (limit 100), account PRs (limit 60), latest 30 handoff comments, active Discussion titles, targeted main README and merged PR searches; cached formal-interface-lemma report. Sparse local notes, unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs are not exhaustively covered.
overlap.same_account_last_24_hours: No relevant predecessor PR was opened in the last 24 hours.
overlap.reservation: Five-indicator negative association; distinct from other locally reserved questions.
